release_notes: Build 66 separates Website and Users from the main workspace with a navigation divider above the Website section.
Website quiz visibility now supports multi-select so Go live now, Follow schedule and Take offline can be applied to several selected quizzes at once.
Website Users now shows each selected account's accepted friends plus incoming and outgoing friend requests alongside quiz activity.
Suspended accounts now receive a clear suspension message when they attempt to log in or use a still-active session.
Factburst quizzes can now be played without signing in. Guest results are calculated statelessly and are not stored in account history or leaderboards.
The signed-in website header is simplified to Welcome {username}; the username links directly to the full profile instead of opening the compact account summary.
Every quiz now has public comments. Anyone can read them, while posting requires a signed-in verified account; suspended/deleted users' comments are hidden automatically.

Website Ads settings can configure optional Google AdSense side-rail display ads. Ads are disabled by default, never use popups/overlays, only appear on wide quiz pages, and no Google ad script loads until enabled.
